$comment: Per-exam authoring contract, declared at S3 (exam-author, 2026-08-17). Themes T1-T8 are the CCAO-F set proposed at S2 in derivation/source-ccas-guide-samples.md and derivation/source-beecham-ccao-f.md (clustered from the 59 available practice items) and ratified here — CCAO-F is a practitioner-productivity exam, so methodology/03-authoring-guide.md's architecture starter set of the same T-prefix does NOT apply; theme_definitions below are authoritative for this package. S4 theme-balance obligation: rebalance toward T1/T2/T4/T7 against the Beecham source's measured T8+T6 skew (48%). pattern_extensions E01-E02 are the two mechanisms both Artefact A documents observed that the shared D01-D20 registry does not name (definitions + evidence in derivation/source-beecham-ccao-f.md; caps in manifest.validation.pattern_caps: E02 0.15). Verticals are authored fresh at S3 as workplace settings for an Associate-level Claude user — none is copied from a source scenario, and per the vendor style card the actor is always a generic job role within the vertical, never a named person or company.

theme_definitions.T1: Entry-point & capability selection — pick the surface, model tier or capability layer that fits the task's shape
theme_definitions.T2: Request specification — turn a vague ask into a complete, decomposable request; name the missing component
theme_definitions.T3: Verification before release — decide what must be checked, against which reference, with what evidence, before it ships
theme_definitions.T4: Review-threshold judgment — decide whether human review is mandatory and who is qualified to give it
theme_definitions.T5: Delegation boundary — split a workflow into AI-appropriate / human-retained / collaborative; place the gate; escalate beyond Associate scope
theme_definitions.T6: Configuration placement & trust boundaries — put a durable requirement in the right mechanism; decide what may carry authority
theme_definitions.T7: Permitted-use & data-sensitivity screening — classify the data and the use case against policy before acting
theme_definitions.T8: Diagnosis & controlled change — isolate the actual cause; change one variable; measure against a baseline
